screen: SEASON STATS — RUSHING, scope NATIONAL, sorted by YARDS descending
method: Thirteen columns across two recordings. IMG_5210 carries GP through LONG, IMG_5211 from TD rightwards to SNAPS, and the six columns they share agree row for row. Both keep the NAME column, so they merge by name; all 400 matched in order. Frames were read in stitched pairs, which is also the only check on columns the screen derives nothing from - it caught J.White's snaps, read once as 870 and confirmed at full resolution as 670.
validation: Three identities hold on all 400 rows: AVG is yards per carry, AVG G is yards per game, and FUM% is fumbles per carry. Independently, 87 players appear in both this list and the PASSING list and their snap counts agree on all 87.
teams: No team column. The quarterbacks tied to a school by the passing merge carry that label here too.
list_length: 400 players — the same cap as the defensive list, ending at F.Meadows on 145 yards.
